integrity: Standalone rational arithmetic checker included; numerical quadrature is a consistency test only; analytic proof establishes all-epsilon asymptotic.
scientific_limitations: Small-epsilon endpoint only; exact epsilon threshold not optimized; full radial CDF not derived; historical priority and independent audit not established. Cube comparison fixes covering radius, not lattice density.
title: Exact three-term covering-radius tail of the four-dimensional root-lattice quantizer
